meta.name: data-quality-frameworks
meta.description: Implement data quality validation with Great Expectations, dbt tests, and data contracts. Use when building data quality pipelines, implementing validation rules, or establishing data contracts.

copy.tagline: 自动验证数据质量,提前发现数据问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责数据管道,需要自动检查数据质量,避免坏数据流入下游。
copy.tagline_en: Catch data issues early with automated quality checks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run data pipelines and want automated quality checks to catch issues early.

howto.what: 当你要检查数据质量时，Claude会按这个技能里的流程，帮你用 Great Expectations、dbt 测试等手段给数据表定检查规则，运行校验，并产出报告。若校验失败，它会给出失败明细。
howto.when: 当你提出构建数据质量管道、实现校验规则、或需要建立数据契约（涉及 Great Expectations、dbt 测试等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我制定数据质量检查计划，包含完整性、一致性等维度
say.note: Claude会结合技能中的质量维度给出可执行的检查项。

say.text: 我要为 customers 和 orders 之间建立数据契约，怎么开始？
say.note: Claude会引导你定义数据结构约束和验证方式。

howto.what_en: When you need to check data quality, Claude follows the workflow in this skill to set validation rules on tables using Great Expectations, dbt tests, run checks, and produce reports, with failure details if any.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build data quality pipelines, implement validation rules, establish data contracts, or use Great Expectations, dbt tests, etc.

say_en.text: Set up non-null and unique checks for order_id in orders using Great Expectations.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the expectation suite and run script.

say_en.text: Help me plan data quality checks covering completeness, consistency, and other dimensions.
say_en.note: Claude will propose actionable checks based on the skill's quality dimensions.

say_en.text: How do I start defining a data contract between customers and orders?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through defining schema constraints and validation.
